observation.command:
cd /workspace; source /usr/local/rvm/scripts/rvm
echo "=== bundle check ==="; bundle check; echo "exit=$?"
echo "=== rails boot ==="; bin/rails runner 'puts "booted env=#{Rails.env}"'; echo "exit=$?"
echo "=== HTTP ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/
echo "=== test db tables ==="; bin/rails runner -e test 'puts ActiveRecord::Base.connection.tables.size'; echo "exit=$?"
